reportTitle: Phase 7A.5R4.2 Quarantine Recovery Proof and Worker Exit Safety Evidence Closure

workerExitProofInvariant.description: recoverQuarantinedDirectory prohibited from releasing quarantine solely based on candidate deletion, candidate absence, timeouts, caller claims, or mere worker.terminate() invocation without authentic Worker exit proof
workerExitProofInvariant.enforcementMechanism: WorkerSupervisor tracks sessions and verifies WorkerExitProof (exit_event or terminate_promise) before candidate deletion
workerExitProofInvariant.strictSequence: Worker exit proof verified -> candidate artifacts and sidecars cleaned -> quarantine released

candidateFileIdentityProtection.description: Candidate file device/inode/mtime/birthtime/size identity captured before verification and checked prior to cleanup to prevent deleting substituted or foreign files

recoveryDeduplicationAndLockout.description: Concurrent recoverQuarantinedDirectory calls deduplicated per directory; concurrent import attempts during active recovery rejected immediately

scenarios.name: terminate() rejects, Worker still alive
scenarios.behavior: Recovery refused with QuarantineRecoveryError; quarantine and candidate file preserved on disk

scenarios.name: terminate() times out, Worker still alive
scenarios.behavior: Recovery refused; quarantine and candidate file preserved on disk

scenarios.name: Candidate deletable by OS permissions, but Worker exit unconfirmed
scenarios.behavior: Recovery refused; candidate file NOT deleted; quarantine preserved

scenarios.name: Candidate absent on disk, but Worker exit unconfirmed
scenarios.behavior: Recovery refused; quarantine preserved despite candidate absence

scenarios.name: Worker delayed exit
scenarios.behavior: Recovery fails before exit; succeeds cleanly after authentic exit event; subsequent import succeeds

scenarios.name: Worker exit concurrent with multiple recovery requests
scenarios.behavior: Recovery deduplicated across 5 concurrent callers; candidate unlinked once; clean quarantine release

scenarios.name: Same directory in quarantine rejects new import
Import concurrent with active recovery
scenarios.behavior: Concurrent import rejected with EcdictImportQuarantinedError while recovery in flight

scenarios.name: Candidate cleanup failure
scenarios.behavior: Quarantine preserved and diagnostic error surfaced when unlink fails

scenarios.name: Foreign file / candidate replacement
scenarios.behavior: Identity mismatch detected; recovery refused; substituted foreign file preserved untouched

scenarios.name: Worker error and exit concurrent
scenarios.behavior: Error preserved fail-closed; no unhandled rejection

scenarios.name: Windows real Worker holding SQLite handle
scenarios.behavior: Handle lock cannot bypass exit proof; recovery cleans up and unquarantines upon confirmed worker exit
